title: The Lucinda Lipol Tour of Boston
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Is this an adults-only experience?: Yes
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Boston is known worldwide for its contributions to freedom, and nothing exemplifies freedom as much as Lucinda's mouth. Her lips do not shy away from giving you the *real* history with a comedic twist. Due to the wide spectrum of words she uses, please understand this tour is for ADULTS ONLY, and proof of age will be requested at the beginning of the tour.
